title: Design tokens v0 (DTCG JSON) and USS export for the locked decisions
summary: Encode the locked design system as machine-readable tokens in the Design Tokens Community Group format with a script that exports USS variables for Unity UI Toolkit. Blocked until the Owner transcribes decisions 1–4.

acceptance_tests.test: design/tokens/tokens.json follows the DTCG format with groups: color (roles, light and dark scrim), typography (≤ 5 steps, tabular HUD numerals), spacing (8 pt grid with 4 pt half step), radius, elevation, motion (150–300 ms UI, 400–600 ms transitions, the shrink transition's own budget).
design/tokens/export_uss.py generates unity/Assets/UI/Tokens.uss deterministically; a test asserts the output matches the committed file.
Contrast test in CI: every text token on the three scans' scrims meets 4.5:1 (icons 3:1).
Token values match DESIGN_SYSTEM.md decisions 1–4 verbatim; the PR cites the transcription commit.

blocked_by: M0-OWNER-02: decisions 1–4 text not yet transcribed into DESIGN_SYSTEM.md
